articles.summary: Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc. (Nasdaq: SBRA) announced today that Rick Matros, the company’s Chair and Chief Executive Officer, Michael Costa, the company’s Chief Financial Officer, Darrin Smith, the company’s Chief Investment Officer, and Lukas Hartwich, the company’s Executive Vice President of Finance, will attend Nareit’s REITworld 2026 Annual Conference November 16 – 19, 2026 at the Atlanta Marriott Marquis in Atlanta, Georgia. About Sabra Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc. , a Maryland corporation, operates as a self-administered, self-managed real estate investment trust (a “REIT”) that, through its subsidiaries, owns and invests in real estate serving the healthcare industry throughout the United States and Canada. Investor Media Inquiries: 1-888-393-8248 or investorinquiries@sabrahealth.com Source: Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc.
articles.title: Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc., to Attend Nareit’s REITworld 2026 Annual Conference

articles.summary: Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc. (“Sabra,” the “Company” or “we”) (Nasdaq: SBRA) today announced its results of operations for the third quarter of 2026. THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS Results per diluted common share for the third quarter of 2026 were as follows: Net Income: $0.11 FFO: $0.40 Normalized FFO: $0.39 AFFO: $0.45 Normalized AFFO: $0.41 EBITDARM Coverage Summary: Skilled Nursing/Transitional Care: 2.52x Senior Housing - Leased: 1.58x Specialty Hospitals and Other: 3.91x On a year-over-year basis, same property Senior Housing Operating Portfolio (“SHOP”) Cash NOI increased 14.6% for the third quarter of 2026. INVESTMENTS AND PORTFOLIO ACTIVITY As previously announced, Sabra closed on the acquisition of seven SHOP communities for an aggregate price of $222.8 million in the third quarter with an estimated yield of 7.7%.
